name: tagpilot-ga4-mcp
description: Free, read-only Google Analytics 4: reports, funnels, realtime and tracking-health checks. Sign in with Google, no Google Cloud setup.
long_description:
Ask Claude about your Google Analytics 4 data: reports, funnels, realtime, property setup, and Tag Pilot tracking-health checks (duplicate purchases, Unassigned and (not set) traffic).

**No Google Cloud setup.** Install, ask a GA4 question, and approve in the browser window that opens: sign in to (or create) your free Tag Pilot account, confirm the code, and allow read-only Google Analytics access. No API key to copy.

**Read-only and private.** The only Google scope is `analytics.readonly`. Your GA4 data goes from your computer straight to Google; Tag Pilot only brokers the token exchange and stores no Google tokens. The refresh token stays on your computer in `~/.config/tagpilot/ga4-mcp`.
